CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Real second step toward a self-hosted PARENA compiler: selfhost/parser.prn, a faithful PARENA-language port of src/parser.c, 51 real assertions cross-checked against the C reference including exact DoD error wording. Found and fixed a real, deeper emitter gap: match-bound Err payloads never had their own type resolved (Ok/Some-only), causing a silent wrong-value bug caught by a real runtime check before shipping. v0.86.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e) (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
